method: Actual xterm windows on an owned Xvfb TCP display; ffmpeg x11grab after actual commands exit 0. Neither HTML/text rendering nor user-desktop capture. Figures are separate SVG/matplotlib assets.
tool: locally extracted xterm; existing Xvfb, ffmpeg; no global changes
capture_driver:
from pathlib import Path
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

script, output, done = map(lambda value: Path(value).resolve(), sys.argv[1:4])
terminal = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "screenshot-tools/root/usr/bin/xterm"
log_path = output.with_suffix(".capture.log")
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
done.unlink(missing_ok=True)
with log_path.open("wb") as log:
    server = subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb", ":99", "-nolisten", "local", "-nolisten", "unix", "-listen", "tcp", "-screen", "0", "1440x960x24", "-ac"], stdout=log, stderr=log)
    terminal_process = None
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Xvfb stopped before the display was ready")
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 6099), timeout=.2):
                    break
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(.1)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Display startup timed out")
        terminal_process = subprocess.Popen([str(terminal), "-display", "127.0.0.1:99", "-geometry", "114x38+0+0", "-fa", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "-fs", "15", "-hold", "-e", "bash", "--noprofile", "--norc", str(script)], stdout=log, stderr=log)
        started = time.monotonic()
        while not done.exists():
            if terminal_process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Terminal closed before the commands finished")
            if time.monotonic() - started > 1300:
                raise RuntimeError("Terminal command completion timed out")
            time.sleep(.25)
        if done.read_text().strip() != "0":
            raise RuntimeError("Terminal commands failed: " + done.read_text().strip())
        time.sleep(.5)
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "x11grab", "-video_size", "1440x960", "-i", "127.0.0.1:99", "-frames:v", "1", "-y", str(output)], check=True, stdout=log, stderr=log)
    finally:
        if terminal_process is not None and terminal_process.poll() is None:
            terminal_process.terminate()
            terminal_process.wait(timeout=10)
        if server.poll() is None:
            server.terminate()
            server.wait(timeout=10)
print(output)
